name: Crush
nameMangling: none found (NF); single underscores, no length cap (V, internal/agent/tools/mcp-tools.go#L58-L60)
listChanged: yes, through ToolListChangedHandler, off for sessionless servers (V, internal/agent/tools/mcp/init.go#L1072-L1078)
notes: Since v0.98 the primary config is crushrc (Bash, run by a built-in interpreter, with `mcp add` builtins); crush.json is deprecated but still loaded, strict JSON (json.Valid, no comments) (V, internal/config/load.go#L968; README.md#L253-L303). tk writes crush.json, which crushrc in the same folder overrides (I, load order). Entry: type (required, stdio|sse|http), command, args, env, url, headers, disabled, timeout. Values get $VAR and $(cmd) shell expansion at load (V), so tk refuses $( and backticks in every value.
